title: Generalizing the interacting dilatonic ghost condensate as a dark energy model
summary: In this article, we study the cosmic evolution of a generalized dilatonic ghost condensate field as a dark energy candidate, formulated from a Lagrangian density with two dominant kinetic terms; one linear and one of arbitrary integer $n>2$ in combination with an exponential potential, which interacts with dark matter through a source term. We analyzed three scenarios: the non-interacting situation $Q=0$ and two different interaction models, $Q\proptoρ_m\dotφ$ and $Q\propto ρ_m H$ to describe the evolution of the present universe.
